item.title: Houston to host top youth robotics competition at GRB for next 7 years
item.description: The Houston First Corporation announced the seven-year deal to hold the event that draws more than 50,000 attendees each year.

item.title: Border Patrol agents who fatally shot Alex Pretti placed on leave: DHS
item.description: DHS sources said that agents are placed on a three-day leave after any officer-involved shooting and receive full pay.

item.title: Joaquin Castro shares Texas detention visit with 5-year-old boy, father captured in Minnesota
item.description: "I told him our country loves him and is praying for him,” said Rep. Castro.

item.title: Harris County property owners urged to pay taxes by Jan. 31 deadline
item.description: Property owners are being urged to make their property tax payments by the Jan. 31 deadline to avoid penalties and interest.

item.title: Man charged with capital murder of couple in west Harris County, HCSO says
item.description: A man has been charged in connection with the murder of a couple that happened last week in west Harris County, officials said.

item.title: Houston event planner, corporate pilot among 6 people killed in Maine plane crash
item.description: As snow from a massive storm began to fall in Bangor, Maine, on Sunday night, six people who had stopped to refuel a Paris-bound luxury jet prepared for takeoff. None would survive the crash that followed, the cause of which remains unknown.

item.title: TDEM offers map to find licensed plumbers amid thawing freeze
item.description: Texas residents urged to hire licensed plumbers for freeze damage repairs. TDEM provides a map to find qualified professionals and avoid fraud.

item.title: Man found dead in hotel room in Channelview, HCSO says
item.description: A man was found dead in a hotel room in Channelview, Harris County officials said.

item.title: Thawing today, watching for patchy freezing fog
item.description: Extreme Cold Warning continues through noon Tuesday with dangerously low wind chills. Temperatures will rise this afternoon.

item.title: Attorney General Ken Paxton demands information from Texas schools about Islamic Games
item.description: Texas attorney general Ken Paxton is asking two Texas school districts to hand over information about their ties to an Islamic youth sports event that he says is sponsored by a terrorist organization.
